name: 美国 EB-2 国家利益豁免
nameEn: United States EB-2 National Interest Waiver
summary: 面向先符合 EB-2 高等学位或特殊才能基础资格，并证明豁免工作邀请和劳工证符合美国国家利益的人士。
summaryEn: For people first qualifying for EB-2 through an advanced degree or exceptional ability who show that waiving the job offer and labor certification benefits the United States.

qualification.summary: 须满足该路线适用的专业资格、经验或成就标准。
qualification.summaryEn: The route-specific qualification, experience or achievement standard must be met.

jobOffer.summary: 获准国家利益豁免时可免除工作邀请和劳工证。
jobOffer.summaryEn: An approved national interest waiver can remove the job-offer and labor-certification requirements.

assessment.summary: 须按申请时官方规则完成相应积分、薪酬、职业、配额或证据审查。
assessment.summaryEn: The applicable points, salary, occupation, quota or evidence assessment must be met under current official rules.

sources.title: United States EB-2 National Interest Waiver
